new: Poricanje holokausta, odnosno ubojstva oko šest milijuna europskih Židova u vrijeme nacionalsocijalizma, u Njemačkoj je kazneno djelo ako se izrazi javno, npr. na skupu ili na internetu.
reason: § 130 Abs. 3 StGB punishes denial only if made publicly or in an assembly and apt to disturb public peace; private denial is not a crime.

old: Holocaustleugnung ist in Deutschland eine Straftat.
new: Öffentliche Holocaustleugnung ist in Deutschland eine Straftat.
reason: § 130 Abs. 3 StGB requires public denial (or in an assembly); unqualified Merksatz is overbroad.

old: Tko je stalno zaposlen, automatski plaća doprinose
new: Tko je stalno zaposlen, u pravilu automatski plaća doprinose
reason: Not every permanent employee pays all four listed contributions: above the Versicherungspflichtgrenze one may be privately health/care insured (§ 6 SGB V); Beamte pay no social insurance.

old: To je privatno osiguranje koje svatko može dobrovoljno sklopiti kod osiguravajuće kuće.
new: To je privatno osiguranje koje se može dobrovoljno sklopiti kod osiguravajuće kuće.
reason: No right to a private life-insurance contract: insurers may refuse or surcharge on health grounds (freedom of contract); 'svatko može' is overbroad.

old: Koalicija CDU/CSU-a i SPD-a naziva se „velika koalicija”.
new: Koalicija CDU/CSU-a i SPD-a tradicionalno se naziva „velika koalicija”.
reason: 'Große Koalition' means a coalition of the two largest parties; since the 2025 election CDU/CSU and SPD are not the two largest groups and the coalition is usually called 'Schwarz-Rot' – time-sensitive.
§ 12/§ 13 BWahlG add further conditions (3 months' residence in Germany or rules for Germans abroad; no exclusion by court), so 'two conditions' is not exhaustive.

old: Kancelara ne bira narod izravno, nego ga bira Bundestag.
new: Kancelara ne bira narod izravno, nego Bundestag, pa najjača stranka ne vlada automatski: vladu čini većina u parlamentu, često koalicija.
reason: Art. 63 GG: the chancellor needs a Bundestag majority; the strongest party is not automatically in government (e.g. CDU/CSU in opposition 1969–1982).

old: imaju ga svi njemački državljani s najmanje 18 godina
new: imaju ga u pravilu njemački državljani s najmanje 18 godina
reason: 'svi' is overbroad: § 12 BWahlG also requires residence (or special rules for Germans abroad), § 13 BWahlG allows exclusion by court.

old: Prag ne vrijedi za stranke nacionalnih manjina, npr. danske manjine.
new: Prag ne vrijedi za stranke nacionalnih manjina (npr. danske manjine) ni za stranku koja pobijedi u najmanje tri izborna okruga.
reason: Besides the minority exemption (§ 4 Abs. 2 BWahlG), the 3-constituency rule (Grundmandatsklausel) still applies per BVerfG 30.7.2024, 2 BvF 1/23 (e.g. Die Linke entered in 2021 with 4.9 %).

old: Parteien brauchen mindestens fünf Prozent der Zweitstimmen.
new: Parteien brauchen in der Regel mindestens fünf Prozent der Zweitstimmen.
reason: Exceptions: national-minority parties and the 3-constituency rule (BVerfG 2 BvF 1/23); Merksatz as absolute rule is false.

new: Stranka u pravilu mora dobiti najmanje 5
reason: Absolute 'mora' ignores the minority exemption and the 3-constituency rule (§ 4 Abs. 2 BWahlG; BVerfG 30.7.2024, 2 BvF 1/23).

old: Tužba protiv otkaza mora se podnijeti u roku od tri tjedna.
new: Tužba protiv otkaza mora se podnijeti u roku od tri tjedna od primitka pisanog otkaza.
reason: § 4 KSchG: the 3-week period runs from receipt of the written notice; a deadline without its starting point can mislead in a real case.

old: Pogrešno parkiranje samo je prekršaj koji se plaća novčanom kaznom, bez suđenja.
new: Pogrešno parkiranje samo je prekršaj koji se plaća novčanom kaznom, u pravilu bez suđenja.
reason: Parking is an Ordnungswidrigkeit, but after an objection (Einspruch) to a Bußgeldbescheid the Amtsgericht decides (§§ 67, 68 OWiG), so 'bez suđenja' is absolute.

new: koji tu dužnost obavlja kao počasnu službu, bez plaće
reason: Schöffenamt is an unpaid Ehrenamt but also a civic duty: once elected it can be refused only on statutory grounds, otherwise Ordnungsgeld (§§ 35, 56 GVG); 'volonterski' suggests it is optional.

old: jasan je primjer antisemitizma i u Njemačkoj je kazneno djelo.
new: jasan je primjer antisemitizma, a javno poricanje u Njemačkoj je kazneno djelo.
reason: § 130 Abs. 3 StGB covers only public denial or denial in an assembly.

old: Den Holocaust zu leugnen ist antisemitisch und strafbar.
new: Den Holocaust zu leugnen ist antisemitisch, öffentlich ist es strafbar.
reason: § 130 Abs. 3 StGB: punishable only when public or in an assembly; Merksatz overbroad.

old: Taj posao obavlja volonterski: ne dobiva plaću,
new: To je počasna služba (Ehrenamt) i građanska dužnost: porotnik ne dobiva plaću,
reason: Schöffenamt is an Ehrenamt that elected citizens must accept unless a statutory ground applies (§§ 33–35, 56 GVG); 'volonterski' implies it is freely optional.

new: kada je proglašen Temeljni zakon (njemački ustav)
